<function name="AddItem" parent="DNotify" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Adds a panel to the notification</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="pnl" type="Panel">The panel to add</arg>
		<arg name="lifeLength" type="number" default="nil">If set, overrides <page>DNotify:SetLife</page> for when the given panel should be removed.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
